overall_assessment: Where UiB has a plan page, extraction is complete and clean: the 19 random controls hold all plan sections, with the year picker, error banners and contact lines correctly left out. The main weakness is pages with no plan, where the text is only the facts box and bare headings. Exam logistics (dates, duration, exam form) sit outside the selector.

findings.description: The exam block (exam form, date, duration, venue, submission deadline) is on the page but not in extracted_text. The plan's 'Vurderingsformer' text is captured, so only the logistics are lost. Exam form and duration is arguably assessment information (for example 'Varigheit 5 timar' and 'Innleveringsfrist' for a portfolio or paper). Dates and rooms are logistics and may be out of scope under the spec.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The exam-information widget is rendered outside div.region-inner.grid, or loads in a separate block.
findings.suggested_fix: If exam form and duration are wanted, add the exam-info container as a second selector and drop dates, rooms and the 'Klokkeslett for oppstart ...' notice with exclude. Otherwise document it as intended in the spec.

findings.description: The 'Utfyllende kursomtale' section repeats four paragraphs word for word from 'Mål og innhold' ('Emnet går over to påfølgande semester ...'). This is duplication in the source page itself, and the extraction faithfully copies it. Section-level counts or text analysis would see the text twice.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Duplication on the source page; no de-duplication of repeated blocks in page_fulltext().
findings.suggested_fix: Optional: drop exact-duplicate paragraphs of 80 or more characters within one text in a UiB post_fn. Low priority.

findings.description: Label and value are separate lines with no separator, so a heading with an empty value is indistinguishable from the next label. Trailing empty headings (for example 'Administrativt ansvarlig' at the end of MATDID350, or '-' placeholders) can be mistaken for values by downstream section splitting.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: html_text of the facts and description blocks puts each dt/dd on its own line, and empty values are not marked.
findings.suggested_fix: Drop trailing empty headings and '-' placeholder values in a post_fn, or render 'Label: value' for the facts box.
